title: Concept: Cookie set without the Secure attribute in javascript — review required
description: In javascript, res.cookie writes a cookie without the Secure attribute. The browser attaches it to http:// requests to the same host, including a redirect an attacker can trigger before HSTS is established. The value then travels in clear text where any hop can read it.
applicability: javascript services that set cookies and are reachable over TLS.
risk: Cookie disclosure over cleartext transport; MEDIUM severity.
